frozen_authority.primary_route: M1-M4仍是正式路线；M2为二维主干，M3为主要非线性模型，M4仅按已批准口径消融/比较
frozen_authority.threshold: max_active_domain(C) < 0.15 kg/kg, epsilon=1e-6, 60 s report resolution with local bracketing
frozen_authority.interpretation: 以上为COMPUTE PASS数值参考，不是扩展模型结果或现实精度证据

scenario_space.generator: 仅由已验证M3/Q3与M4/Q4有限体积求解器生成标签；不得用代理自身生成真值

bounded_core.boundary_profile_perturbation: 保持附件1端点和物理范围的低维平滑扰动；幅值不得超出预注册范围

scenario_space.extrapolation_shell: 每次仅一个连续参数落在核心区间外10%-25%，其余保持核心区间；不得越过正物性、正半径和经验式定义域
scenario_space.sampling: 固定候选池上的maximin Latin hypercube；Q3/Q4各60工况

split.unit: 整条工况轨迹；同一工况的所有空间点和时刻只能属于一个集合
no_leakage: 标准化统计量只由训练集计算
早停与超参数只看训练/验证集
测试集只在模型冻结后评一次
网格节点随机拆分禁止

evaluation_grid.coordinate: xi=r/R(t) for common field comparison; additionally report physical r where active
evaluation_grid.time: 0:1800:216000 s plus each reference threshold bracket and prescribed result-grid times
evaluation_grid.interpolation: all outputs conservatively mapped from native grid to this fixed evaluation grid

field: volume-weighted RMSE for T and C
volume-weighted MAE for T and C
maximum absolute error for T and C
relative L2 error with denominator floor declared before execution
events: absolute and signed Q3 threshold-time error in s
absolute and signed Q4 threshold-time error in s
false-safe rate: predicted max(C)<0.15 while reference does not
physics: normalized global energy balance residual where T is solved
cellwise PDE residual L2 and Linf on an independent audit stencil
Robin boundary residual and axis-symmetry residual
Q4 dry-solid continuity, geometry/Jacobian error and outside-domain prediction count
cost: trainable parameter count or degrees of freedom
break-even number of calls against M3/M4
data_sensitivity: same metrics at 18, 36 and 72 training scenarios

timing_protocol: same machine, software environment and precision; one warm-up, then at least 20 inference repetitions; PDE/CFD solve timing includes assembly and solve but excludes common input parsing; training time includes preprocessing and early stopping

surrogate_or_ml: median Q3/Q4 absolute event error <= 600 s and worst <= 1800 s
all three seeds meet safety rules
pinn: beats the same-observation unconstrained inverse baseline by >=20% median parameter relative error or field RMSE
identified parameter 95% interval has finite width and covers synthetic truth in >=90% of trials
no worse than 600 s median threshold-time error
physics residual is lower than pure-ML baseline on the independent audit stencil
cfd: new phase/capillary mechanism changes a preregistered decision metric by more than combined discretization uncertainty
mass balance <=1e-5 and mesh/time refinement changes event time <=60 s
added parameters pass profile-identifiability or are fixed from allowed literature
runtime and memory stay within the stated budget

rejection_and_fallback: 任何方法出现测试泄漏、非物理解、未报告失败运行或无法复现，直接拒绝该补充模型
外推不达门槛时仅允许标注为核心区间内插值器，不得扩大适用域
复杂模型未超过对应简单基线的预注册门槛时回退到简单基线
补充实验无论成败均不得修改M1-M4、COMPUTE PASS或result1-result4
